description: Delegation-of-Authority band: which approver role may approve a governed action whose total falls in an amount band, effective-dated. Amount bounds carry NO real value in the repo; they are seeded out-of-repo. Until (action x amount x date) resolves to exactly one active band+role the action HARD-BLOCKS (authority_unknown); unconfigured action HARD-BLOCKS (doa_band_unconfigured). Never a default approver.

fields.description: The governed action this authority band applies to.
fields.label: Governed Action

fields.description: Ascending authority rank within the action (1 = lowest band). Higher band = higher approval authority.
fields.label: Band Sequence

fields.description: Only an active band participates in authority resolution. A revision supersedes by activating a new row, never by editing a live band.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: Band lower bound (inclusive). WITHHELD in the repo: no default, seeded out-of-repo from the owner's DoA policy. Never invented.
fields.label: Amount From

fields.description: Band upper bound (inclusive). Leave blank for the top, open-ended band that escalates to the Owner. WITHHELD: no default, seeded out-of-repo.
fields.label: Amount To

fields.description: The role that may APPROVE an action whose total falls in this band.
fields.label: Required Role

fields.description: The next band-up / Owner role authority escalates to. Owner sits ABOVE the bands, outside the SoD pair, and is never a substitute checker.
fields.label: Escalates To

fields.description: Date this band takes effect. Authority is resolved against the band in force on the action's date.
fields.label: Effective From

fields.description: Date this band stops being effective. Blank = open-ended.
fields.label: Effective To

name: DoA Band
